claims.head: Special teams lean toward the Stars
claims.call: The Stars’ power play creates at least their usual 8.7 expected goals per 60.
claims.body: The Sharks’ penalty kill is near the bottom of the league, and the Stars’ power play is one of the league’s best. Discipline matters more than usual for the Sharks tonight.
claims.nums: Dallas 3rd for power play (8.7 expected goals per 60) · San Jose 24th for penalty kill
claims.gist: The Stars’ power play has a soft target in the Sharks’ kill.
claims.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 2 and 2 games this season

check.measure: expected goals per 60 on the power play
check.rule: held if tonight's figure is at or above the team's usual level; partly if between the league average and that level; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: Expect a grind
claims.call: The game runs at fewer than 75.6 shots per 60 at 5-on-5, slower than either team’s usual.
claims.body: San Jose plays some of the league’s slowest games, and so does Dallas. We think this one is even quieter than either team’s usual.
claims.nums: Pace (shots per 60 at 5-on-5, both teams): San Jose 26th (79.5), Dallas 32nd (75.6)
claims.gist: Both teams play slow, low-event hockey.

check.measure: shots per 60 at 5-on-5 (blocked shots left out), both teams combined, adjusted for score and venue
check.rule: held if tonight's pace is below the slower team's usual; partly if below the league average; otherwise didn't happen

DAL.head: Dallas should have the upper hand
DAL.body: Dallas has had more of the chances over recent games and has home ice. San Jose can make it interesting if they keep shots to a minimum.

SJS.head: Not an easy night for San Jose
SJS.body: Dallas has had more of the chances over recent games and has home ice. San Jose’s best way through is keeping shots to a minimum.

story.head: Hintz’s favourite opponent
paras: The Stars won the first meeting this season, 5-0 in Dallas. The Sharks come in at 2-1-0, the Stars at 1-2-0.
The Stars’ power play has a soft target in the Sharks’ kill. Both teams play slow, low-event hockey.
